sql: SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'driver'
SELECT avg(CASE WHEN ball_flight_code = 1 THEN 1e0 ELSE 0e0 END) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'driver' AND ball_flight_code IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT max(carry_m) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'driver'
SELECT avg(carry_m) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'iron'

q: 골프존에서 라운드를 총 몇 번 했어?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT session_key) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE source = 'golfzon'
SELECT club FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE ball_flight_code = 2 GROUP BY club ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

q: 드라이버 카드에서 가장 많이 나온 고칠 점은 뭐야?
sql: SELECT fix_key FROM lakehouse.gold.fix_frequency WHERE club_group = 'driver' AND fix_key <> '(none)' ORDER BY cards DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT straight_rate FROM lakehouse.gold.monthly_trend WHERE club_group = 'driver' AND month = TIMESTAMP '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
SELECT avg(s.m_tempo_ratio) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_swing s JOIN lakehouse.silver.fact_video v ON v.video_id = s.video_id WHERE v.club_group = 'driver'
SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'driver' AND shot_at LIKE '2026-09-30%'

q: 훅이 난 드라이버 샷의 평균 비거리는?
sql: SELECT avg(carry_m) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE club_group = 'driver' AND ball_flight_code = 3

q: 분석 신뢰도가 낮음인 카드는 몇 장이야?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_card WHERE confidence = '낮음'

q: 드라이버를 가장 많이 친 달은 언제야?
sql: SELECT month FROM lakehouse.gold.monthly_trend WHERE club_group = 'driver' ORDER BY shots DESC LIMIT 1

q: 드라이버 스트레이트 샷과 슬라이스 샷의 백스윙 골반 이동 평균을 각각 알려줘
sql: SELECT v.ball_flight_code, avg(s.m_pelvis_sway_top_sw) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_swing s JOIN lakehouse.silver.fact_video v ON v.video_id = s.video_id WHERE v.club_group = 'driver' AND v.ball_flight_code IN (1, 2) GROUP BY v.ball_flight_code

q: 내가 앱으로 직접 업로드한 영상은 몇 개야?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM lakehouse.silver.fact_video WHERE source = 'upload'
